AuditEvent.description: One link of the hash chain. Only pseudonymous ids and closed-vocabulary tokens appear.
AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent

AuditVerificationView.description: Role-aware chain check. Couple members see only `ok` and their own couple's event count.
AuditVerificationView.title: AuditVerificationView

CarrierFrequency.description:
A carrier frequency with its provenance, or an explicit illustrative flag.

`kind` says what `value` means: the heterozygote carrier frequency for an autosomal recessive condition, or the
variant allele frequency among males (which equals the hemizygous prevalence) for an X-linked one.
CarrierFrequency.title: CarrierFrequency

CbcInput.description: Complete blood count plus context. Every numeric field may be null (the result is then 'incomplete').

alpha0_origin_both_high_or_unknown.title: Alpha0 Origin Both High Or Unknown

CbcInput.title: CbcInput

ClinicianProforma.description:
The clinician-filled part of the 12-field proforma. The other fields are filled by the system.

There is no marriage-decision field, and `extra="forbid"` rejects one if a client sends it.
ClinicianProforma.title: ClinicianProforma

ClinicianRecord.description: The assembled 12 fields: clinician input plus what the system knows (fields 2, 9, 10, 12).
ClinicianRecord.title: ClinicianRecord

ClosureAnswers.description: The eight original patient items (all optional), the optional SILS stratifier, service interest.
ClosureAnswers.title: ClosureAnswers

ConsentBasis.description:
Why a record exists. The mandatory couple screening is NOT consent-based.

Federal Decree-Law 49/2023 Art. 4(2)(a) exempts the obligatory screening 'mentioned in this
Law' from the consent requirement and Art. 15 makes couple screening obligatory. Consent
governs voluntary and secondary uses and the sharing of one person's findings with someone
else. A `STATUTORY_OBLIGATION` record documents the legal basis, confers no sharing scope and
cannot be revoked.
ConsentBasis.title: ConsentBasis

ConsentRecord.description: The folded (read) view of the append-only ledger: a grant plus its revocation, if any.
ConsentRecord.title: ConsentRecord

ConsentScope.description: How much of ONE person's findings a recipient may see. Ordered by `SCOPE_RANK`.
ConsentScope.title: ConsentScope

CounsellorBrief.description:
A one-page, grounded brief for the human who will see the couple. Facts and sources only;
it is not clinical advice and it makes no recommendation.
CounsellorBrief.title: CounsellorBrief

CoupleCase.description: The case record. `state` is the pathway state; the event log lives in the service.
CoupleCase.title: CoupleCase

CoupleResult.description: The engine's whole answer. Deterministic: same inputs give the same object.
CoupleResult.title: CoupleResult

DetectionStatement.description: What the panel can and cannot rule out. Detection rate, never a residual-risk number.
DetectionStatement.title: DetectionStatement

Emirate.description: Which emirate's published disclosure standard a policy follows.
Emirate.title: Emirate

notice.default: Deterministic triggers with sources. Every trigger and tier needs clinical sign-off (pending); triggers flagged needs_legal_read need a legal read. A human decides what happens next.
notice.title: Notice

EscalationRecord.description: A queue entry for the counsellor queue. Holds decisions only, never the person's words.
EscalationRecord.title: EscalationRecord

FamilyHistoryItem.description: Controlled list, so nothing free-typed about a family is stored.
FamilyHistoryItem.title: FamilyHistoryItem

Finding.description: One interpreted line of a laboratory report (the programme ingests the lab's category).
Finding.title: Finding

GlossaryEntry.description: A plain-language definition. Arabic and Urdu entries are drafts pending native review.
GlossaryEntry.title: GlossaryEntry

GovernedDisclosure.description:
`DisclosedResult` plus what the contract has no field for.

`partner_gene_names` carries the partner's gene names under the `gene_names_only` scope
(the contract's `partner_findings` holds whole `Finding` objects, which would include the
zygosity, so it stays empty at that scope). `member_findings` is staff views only.
GovernedDisclosure.title: GovernedDisclosure

GrantBody.description: The subject is always the caller: nobody grants consent for someone else's findings.

recipient.description: A role value or a pseudonymous person id
recipient.title: Recipient

GrantBody.title: GrantBody

HaemInterpretRequest.description: `POST /v1/haem/interpret` body. Omit `hplc` for a CBC-only work-up.
HaemInterpretRequest.title: HaemInterpretRequest

HaemInterpretation.description: The aid's whole answer. Deterministic: same inputs give the same object.
HaemInterpretation.title: HaemInterpretation

HaemRulesView.description: What `GET /v1/haem/rules` returns: the rule table with its provenance and sign-off status.

forbidden_outputs_unless_a_cited_guideli.title: Forbidden Outputs Unless A Cited Guideline Allows

HaemRulesView.title: HaemRulesView

HplcInput.description: Haemoglobin analysis by HPLC or capillary electrophoresis. Null fields give 'incomplete'.
HplcInput.title: HplcInput

IconArraySpec.description: Fixed 100-icon part-to-whole array (a pre-registered framing choice).
IconArraySpec.title: IconArraySpec

IdType.description: A setting, never a number: no identifier is ever stored (ADR 0002).
IdType.title: IdType

IntakeInput.description: Intake for a couple. `synthetic` must be true: the prototype accepts no real people.
IntakeInput.title: IntakeInput

ItemResult.description: Item-level only. There is deliberately no total score and no scale score.
ItemResult.title: ItemResult

LocusGroup.description: Conditions at one locus whose carriers can pair into a disease state across conditions.
LocusGroup.title: LocusGroup

MemberFindings.description: Staff view only: one couple member's findings, attributed.
MemberFindings.title: MemberFindings

MemberInput.description: One synthetic partner. The name must be made up.
MemberInput.title: MemberInput

NextStepStatus.description: Status of the next CLINICAL step. Not a marriage decision.
NextStepStatus.title: NextStepStatus

NumberRef.description: A number that appears in rendered text, with where it came from.
NumberRef.title: NumberRef

notice.default: Simulated demo authentication on synthetic data. Not production authentication: a production deployment would use the national identity provider (UAE PASS, Emirates ID).
notice.title: Notice

OutcomeLine.description: One natural-frequency line, always out of 100 pregnancies (fixed denominator).
OutcomeLine.title: OutcomeLine

PanelInfo.description: A demonstration panel with an ASSUMED detection rate (never a measured one).
PanelInfo.title: PanelInfo

PersonReport.description: A reported screening result for one person (synthetic).

Principal.description: Who is calling. Demo auth only: a signed token carries exactly this.
Principal.title: Principal

ProgrammeKpis.description: Aggregated from the stored cases only. A figure with no data behind it is None, never invented.

ReferralTask.description: FHIR R5 Task shaped. Simulated: there is no FHIR server and no integration.
ReferralTask.title: ReferralTask

Relationship.description: Degree of relatedness between the partners (as declared at intake).
Relationship.title: Relationship

ResultCategory.description:
The only three result labels the product may show a couple.

Never "compatible", "incompatible", "pass", "fail", "no risk" or high/moderate/low.
ResultCategory.title: ResultCategory

ResultReference.description: What the journey needs to know about the result: the category and, optionally, the headline number.
ResultReference.title: ResultReference

ResultView.description: What one viewer sees: the disclosure-filtered result and its rendered explanation.
ResultView.title: ResultView

ReviewPriority.description: Staff-only. Never shown to the couple.
ReviewPriority.title: ReviewPriority

ServiceInterest.description: Opt-in "interested in future services". Never a marriage field; never shown to a partner.
ServiceInterest.title: ServiceInterest

notice.default: Simulated demo authentication on synthetic data. Not production authentication: a production deployment would use the national identity provider (UAE PASS, Emirates ID).
notice.title: Notice

SourceRef.description: A cited source and an honest statement of what this build actually read of it.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

TaskMilestones.title: TaskMilestones

TaskStatus.description: Subset of the FHIR R5 Task status value set (5.0.0, fetched 2026-11-20).
TaskStatus.title: TaskStatus
